name: moe_align_single_token
description: Aligns the distinct expert ids of a single token for grouped MoE dispatch. topk_ids is [1,K] int32 and must contain distinct experts. Returns sorted_ids [K*block_size] int32 (K at every position except block starts, original expert slots at block starts in ascending expert order), experts [K] int32 sorted ascending, and num_post [1] int32 equal to K*block_size. No input is mutated. Current tests exercise K 1..8 and block_size 16/64/128.
